title: Registry: topology (4 nodes + VIP + datastore backends)
description: Runs `nexus topology registry`. Renders the 2 Harbor app nodes (with component counts), the PG primary/replica + Redis roles, the registry-db.nexus.lab VIP .119 pseudo-node, and the MinIO s3://harbor blob-store backend. Not sharded.

observe.what: 4 nodes + the VIP pseudo-node (-> the PG primary) + the MinIO s3://harbor blob-store info node; app nodes annotated 8/8 components

whatProves: RegistryAdapter.TopologyAsync annotates each node with its role + the live datastore roles, appends the VRRP VIP + the MinIO blob-store backend as pseudo-nodes; Shards = null (Harbor is not data-sharded).
